name: PumkinParty
source:
You decide to go to a halloween party your friend invited you to. Only for you to go and find out none of your friends arrived. Will you stay or leave? That's your choice.

[From [url=https://ifruitbasket.itch.io/pumkinparty]Itch.io[/url]]
